prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Empire C02 science-fiction skill icon. One isolated genuine transparent RGBA cutout on a square 1254×1254 canvas, designed to read at actual 48×48 with center anchor [24,24].
Input roles: Image 1 is the exact verified original high-resolution skill-board subject card and determines functional subject, broad colors and action direction. Its magenta outside and rectangular scene/card background must NOT be copied. Image 2 is accepted C02 cargo-crate STYLE ONLY: imitate chunky simplified masses, confident heavy contour, broad matte planes and restrained cel-shaded values; do not copy crates or cargo hardware.
Style: Exaggerated chunky hand-drawn cartoon sci-fi shapes with thick stable dark contour and clear opaque material planes. Two or three value steps per material, few essential seams, tiny bounded highlights. Large functional forms replace micro-panels, rivets, scratches and noise. No photorealism, glossy 3D, oil paint, dense edge wear, medieval gear or broad glow.
Composition: Keep the original functional motif as one tightly grouped centered icon. Entire icon including action glyphs stays inside 6–8% empty transparent margins, with no clipped tips. No text, logo, watermark, badge rim, rectangular background tile, decorative floor, cast shadow or unrelated UI panel.
Transparency: true transparent exterior and open gaps. Physical parts and action glyphs are opaque colored shapes. No painted checkerboard, white/magenta/black backdrop, mist, aura, bloom, light bleed or colored fringe. Bounded action glyphs may be bright but must have clean hard edges with no exterior illumination.
Primary request: Rebuild 切换道岔 / switch rail. Preserve the original compact overhead-oblique railway junction: a round mechanical graphite switch hub with a small cyan center, and four short splayed paired-rail branches extending toward upper-left, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right, producing a broad X-shaped cutout. Retain broad dark sleepers under short gray steel rails. The upper-right branch has one broad amber/orange selected rail strip as in the source. Exactly TWO bounded action arrows straddle the center: a pale cyan arrow curves outward toward the LEFT and slightly down; an amber/orange arrow points horizontally RIGHT. The original flat stone square ground tile is removed; keep only the actual rails, essential sleepers, switch hub and two arrows with transparent spaces between the branches. Simplify sleeper count and minor bolts for 48px readability. Preserve switch-routing function, not a new tactical map, railway station or circular transit logo. No third arrow, train, extra node, target reticle, glowing track or ground plate.
